user.title: Connect K9SNTNL
user.description: In the K9SNTNL app, open **My account → Home Assistant → Connect Home Assistant** and enter the code shown there. It is valid for 10 minutes.

data_description.url: Only change this if you run your own K9SNTNL server.

reauth_confirm.title: Reconnect K9SNTNL
reauth_confirm.description: The connection was disconnected in the app or has expired (e.g. after signing out on all devices or a new password). Create a new code in the app under **My account → Home Assistant** and enter it here.

error.invalid_code: The code is invalid or has expired. Please create a new one in the app.
error.too_many_attempts: Too many wrong codes. Please wait 15 minutes.
error.cannot_connect: The K9SNTNL server could not be reached.

abort.already_configured: This K9SNTNL account is already connected.
abort.wrong_account: The code belongs to a different K9SNTNL account.
